name: pay-on-proof
description: Pay on Proof: an escrow on NEAR that pays agents when their delivery passes an on-chain check

scripts.build: cd contract && RUSTFLAGS='--cfg near' cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && mkdir -p target/near && wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-sign-ext --enable-mutable-globals --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-reference-types --enable-multivalue --strip-debug target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/pay_on_proof.wasm -o target/near/pay_on_proof.wasm
